review.notes: All twelve actual objects inspected individually in enlarged source-coordinate crops and rechecked with source-context outline overlays. Complete visible glove fingers, can handles/spout, teapot spout/finial, ribbon including its loose forked end, and both snail antennae are retained. Enclosed handle gaps and large foreground overlaps are excluded where applicable. Source-context previews preserve full visible identities. Authored clarity and modest-overlap intent relative to scene 24; player difficulty review and real-iPhone testing are still pending.

targets.name: Red apple
targets.notes: Upper body and visible stem retained; the twig overlaps the lower apple. Context preview retains that natural overlap.

targets.name: Closed red book
targets.notes: The complete exposed page block and red covers remain visible. Ivy overlaps the right quarter.

targets.name: White bird ornament
targets.notes: Beak, head, breast and visible feet are outlined; trailing foliage overlaps the rear wing and tail.

targets.name: Striped glove
targets.notes: Full cuff and all five visible finger shapes are retained; foliage crosses the wrist.

targets.name: Blue floral teapot
targets.notes: The entire visible lid finial, curved spout, foot and exposed lower handle are included. The left flowerpot obscures most of the handle.

targets.name: Wicker basket
targets.notes: The whole exposed basket body and arched handle are traced; its left side is naturally hidden behind the timber post.

targets.name: Brass watering can
targets.notes: Complete top arch, exposed rear grip, long spout and sprinkler rose are retained. The handle opening and brace gap are excluded; rose foliage overlaps the lower left quarter.

targets.name: Blue-handled trowel
targets.notes: The full blue handle, hanging hole, metal collar, shaft and visible blade are traced.

targets.name: Purple ribbon spool
targets.notes: The complete loose ribbon, including both forked end points, is part of this target. Folded linen overlaps the lower left of the spool.

targets.name: Cream scallop shell
targets.notes: The scalloped edge and fan ribs remain clear. The right-edge flower overlap and enclosed foreground daisy are excluded from the reveal outline.

targets.name: Yellow boot
targets.notes: The full rim, shaft, toe, sole and heel are retained. Large foreground daisies are excluded where enclosed; small stems and leaves remain in the contextual preview.

targets.name: Wooden snail
targets.notes: Both complete antennae, the spiral shell and the visible foot are included. A fern overlaps only the very bottom.
